resources.string: No account. Your data stays on this device.
A deterministic summary of saved data. No AI provider or internet needed.
Strap history is still syncing or scoring. This summary is provisional.
Choose local notifications. New summaries are off until enabled. Delivery uses saved data and respects OS permission and quiet hours.
System notifications are blocked. Enable them in Android settings.
Plan notifications need a saved local plan. No notification is generated when plan data is unavailable.
No scored metrics are available yet. Sync your strap to build a local summary.
Your strap has been disconnected for at least five minutes. Open Device to check the connection.
Your connected strap has reported off-wrist for at least 30 minutes. Wear it when you want to record.
The optional scheduled Coach brief uses your own provider, key, and data-sharing consent. It can send selected data off this device. Local summaries do not use it.
Battery alerts also cover critical runtime, charge before bed, and a low last-seen reading while disconnected. All use the same battery-alert setting.
Equal start and end times turn off the quiet-hour window.
Sleep need and debt are not included in this summary. Open Alarms to review your saved sleep plan.
Charging fault alerts are unavailable because the device data does not establish a charger fault.
